name: fhi-rate-card-workspace
description: Workspace for reusable FHI rate card component packages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @fhi/rate-card-core && npm run build -w @fhi/rate-card-angular && npm run build -w @fhi/rate-card-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @fhi/rate-card-core && npm run typecheck -w @fhi/rate-card-angular && npm run typecheck -w @fhi/rate-card-react
